how: West London Shooting School offers one-to-one clay shooting lessons for beginners, with guns and cartridges supplied.
Chel-Ski in Chelsea runs lessons on rotating-carpet indoor ski slopes; Skieasy at Dukes Meadows in Chiswick uses the same type of track.
Royal Docks Outriggers paddles outrigger canoes from the London Regatta Centre on weekend mornings, with no experience needed.
Queen Mary Sailing Club runs two-day RYA keelboat courses on Sonar keelboats, with places reserved for members of the Royal Thames Yacht Club and guests.
